metadata.title: Consent Revocation & Access Invalidation Matrix Across Operational Surfaces
metadata.benchmarkStandard: p99 <= 500 ms SLA across online surfaces

surfaces.invalidationMechanism: Database-level policy check & Postgres trigger enforcement
Elastic/Postgres Full-Text Index tombstoning & cache purge event
surfaces.remedialAction: Worker profile removed from public search results immediately

surfaces.invalidationMechanism: CDN tag-based cache purge API call + local Redis key eviction
surfaces.remedialAction: Edge responds with HTTP 404/410 Gone post-eviction

surfaces.invalidationMechanism: Real-time W3C Bitstring Status List lookup against Postgres database
surfaces.offlineBoundaryBehavior: Falls back to cryptographic signature check only if offline
surfaces.remedialAction: Verification portal displays banner: 'Worker profile consent revoked'

surfaces.invalidationMechanism: WebSocket invalidation event + Server-Sent Events (SSE) broadcast
surfaces.offlineBoundaryBehavior: Cached client state invalidates upon reconnection
surfaces.remedialAction: Profile blurred with notice: 'Consent withdrawn by artisan'

surfaces.invalidationMechanism: Webhook broadcast to subscribed BAP/BPP endpoints with SHA-256 HMAC
surfaces.remedialAction: Partner required by contract to evict worker from catalog within 5 minutes

surfaces.invalidationMechanism: Signed URL instant revocation & storage object ACL invalidation
surfaces.offlineBoundaryBehavior: Previously downloaded PDF/JSON files cannot be remotely deleted
surfaces.remedialAction: Direct download links return 403 Forbidden with ACCESS_REVOKED

surfaces.invalidationMechanism: Token blacklist in Redis with worker_id scope + jti revocation list
surfaces.offlineBoundaryBehavior: JWT rejected upon next gateway touch

surfaces.invalidationMechanism: Cryptographic expiration date + Periodic offline status bundle sync
surfaces.offlineBoundaryBehavior: PHYSICAL BOUNDARY: Air-gapped verifier cannot know about online revocation until synced
surfaces.remedialAction: Offline verifiers MUST warn: 'Offline signature valid, but online status unverified. Check validity within 72 hours.'

benchmarkMethodology.testHarness: Node.js 24 + tsx multi-path async test runner
benchmarkMethodology.environment: Local staging sandbox / AWS Mumbai testbed simulation
